name: slide-images
title_zh: 讲稿里缺图就现场造一张，Marp 指令顺手写好
tagline_zh: 讲着讲着发现这页没图？它去翻 meme、截屏、画图表，或现场调 Graphviz/matplotlib 出图。
tagline_en: Slide needs a visual mid-lecture? It hunts memes, screenshots, charts, or renders Graphviz/matplotlib on the.
desc_en: Find or make an image for a slide - a meme, a screenshot, a chart, or a diagram (Graphviz, matplotlib) - and place it in the week's assets folder with the right Marp image directive. Use when a slide needs a visual, when the user asks for a meme, figure, diagram, chart, or picture, or when deck QA reports a missing image.
why_zh: 不是丢给你一张图就完事——它认 deck 的目录结构、按周归档、生成正确的图片指令。
why_en: Doesn't just hand you an image—it respects the deck's folder layout, files by week, and emits the exact Marp directive, closing.
limit_zh: 只处理单张幻灯片配图需求；不批量补全整个 deck 的缺图，不重绘已有图片，也不负责图片版权核查。
limit_en: Handles one slide's visual at a time; won't batch-fill a deck, redraw existing images, or check copyright. Stops and asks if a source sits behind a.
title_en: Make or find slide images, Marp directive included
